us-20261103-news-1.title: 冷却的劳动力市场中的假日招聘：临时工作减少，自动化程度提高

segments.src: Every autumn, retailers, warehouses and delivery companies ramp up hiring to handle the year-end rush.
segments.tr: Every autumn, retailers, warehouses and delivery companies ramp up hiring to handle the year-end rush.

segments.src: This year the picture looks different.
segments.tr: This year the picture looks different.

segments.src: Many employers are still adding seasonal workers, but several are offering fewer temporary positions than in past years and are leaning more heavily on automation in their fulfillment centers.
segments.tr: Many employers are still adding seasonal workers, but several are offering fewer temporary positions than in past years and are leaning more heavily on automation in their fulfillment centers.

segments.src: For job seekers, that changes where the opportunities are, how long they may last and what skills help candidates stand out.
segments.tr: For job seekers, that changes where the opportunities are, how long they may last and what skills help candidates stand out.

segments.src: ## What Seasonal Hiring Usually Looks Like
segments.tr: ## What Seasonal Hiring Usually Looks Like

segments.src: Seasonal hiring has long been a barometer of business confidence.
segments.tr: Seasonal hiring has long been a barometer of business confidence.

segments.src: Retailers add cashiers, stock clerks and floor staff.
segments.tr: Retailers add cashiers, stock clerks and floor staff.

segments.src: Shippers and logistics firms add package handlers, drivers and sorting-center workers.
segments.tr: Shippers and logistics firms add package handlers, drivers and sorting-center workers.

segments.src: Many of these roles run from roughly October through early January, and a share of them turn into permanent jobs for people who perform well.
segments.tr: Many of these roles run from roughly October through early January, and a share of them turn into permanent jobs for people who perform well.

segments.src: In years when the labor market was very tight, employers competed hard for workers.
segments.tr: In years when the labor market was very tight, employers competed hard for workers.

segments.src: They raised starting pay, offered sign-on bonuses and ran large hiring events.
segments.tr: They raised starting pay, offered sign-on bonuses and ran large hiring events.

segments.src: When hiring conditions cool, that urgency fades.
segments.tr: When hiring conditions cool, that urgency fades.

segments.src: ## What Is Different This Year
segments.tr: ## What Is Different This Year

segments.src: Several trends are shaping this year's holiday hiring season:
segments.tr: Several trends are shaping this year's holiday hiring season:

segments.src: - **More cautious headcount plans.** Many companies are being careful about costs after a period of slower consumer spending growth and elevated borrowing costs. Rather than hiring aggressively "just in case," they are planning for expected demand and relying on existing staff for extra hours.
segments.tr: - **More cautious headcount plans.** Many companies are being careful about costs after a period of slower consumer spending growth and elevated borrowing costs. Rather than hiring aggressively "just in case," they are planning for expected demand and relying on existing staff for extra hours.

segments.src: - **More automation in warehouses.** Robotic picking systems, automated sorting lines and conveyor technology now handle tasks that once required large temporary crews. This does not remove the need for people, but it can reduce how many short-term hires a facility needs for the same volume of orders.
segments.tr: - **More automation in warehouses.** Robotic picking systems, automated sorting lines and conveyor technology now handle tasks that once required large temporary crews. This does not remove the need for people, but it can reduce how many short-term hires a facility needs for the same volume of orders.

segments.src: - **A shift in the type of work.** Demand is moving toward roles that support automated systems, such as equipment operators, quality checkers, inventory control staff and technicians, alongside traditional hands-on handling.
segments.tr: - **A shift in the type of work.** Demand is moving toward roles that support automated systems, such as equipment operators, quality checkers, inventory control staff and technicians, alongside traditional hands-on handling.

segments.src: - **Earlier and shorter hiring windows.** Some employers are bringing in workers earlier and for tighter periods, matching schedules more closely to forecasted peaks instead of keeping large pools on standby.
segments.tr: - **Earlier and shorter hiring windows.** Some employers are bringing in workers earlier and for tighter periods, matching schedules more closely to forecasted peaks instead of keeping large pools on standby.

segments.src: - **Greater use of existing workers.** Offering current part-time employees more hours is often cheaper and faster than onboarding new people.
segments.tr: - **Greater use of existing workers.** Offering current part-time employees more hours is often cheaper and faster than onboarding new people.

segments.src: Exact numbers vary by company and region, and official figures are revised over time, so it is worth checking recent releases from sources such as the U.S.
segments.tr: Exact numbers vary by company and region, and official figures are revised over time, so it is worth checking recent releases from sources such as the U.S.

segments.src: Bureau of Labor Statistics and industry groups like the National Retail Federation for the latest data.
segments.tr: Bureau of Labor Statistics and industry groups like the National Retail Federation for the latest data.

segments.src: ## What This Means for Job Seekers
segments.tr: ## What This Means for Job Seekers

segments.src: A cooler market does not mean there are no jobs.
segments.tr: A cooler market does not mean there are no jobs.

segments.src: It means the search takes more strategy.
segments.tr: It means the search takes more strategy.

segments.src: 1. **Apply early.** Fewer openings and tighter windows mean the best shifts and locations can fill quickly.
segments.tr: 1. **Apply early.** Fewer openings and tighter windows mean the best shifts and locations can fill quickly.

segments.src: 2. **Be flexible.** Availability for nights, weekends and multiple locations makes a candidate easier to place.
segments.tr: 2. **Be flexible.** Availability for nights, weekends and multiple locations makes a candidate easier to place.

segments.src: 3. **Highlight technology comfort.** Familiarity with handheld scanners, warehouse management software or basic equipment operation can set an applicant apart.
segments.tr: 3. **Highlight technology comfort.** Familiarity with handheld scanners, warehouse management software or basic equipment operation can set an applicant apart.

segments.src: 4. **Look beyond the obvious employers.** Grocers, restaurants, event venues, hospitality businesses and local delivery services also see holiday surges.
segments.tr: 4. **Look beyond the obvious employers.** Grocers, restaurants, event venues, hospitality businesses and local delivery services also see holiday surges.

segments.src: 5. **Ask about conversion.** If you want a lasting job, ask during the interview whether seasonal staff are considered for permanent openings.
segments.tr: 5. **Ask about conversion.** If you want a lasting job, ask during the interview whether seasonal staff are considered for permanent openings.

segments.src: 6. **Compare total compensation.** Pay rates, guaranteed hours, shift differentials, and benefits such as employee discounts or schedule flexibility can differ widely.
segments.tr: 6. **Compare total compensation.** Pay rates, guaranteed hours, shift differentials, and benefits such as employee discounts or schedule flexibility can differ widely.

segments.src: 7. **Verify every offer.** Seasonal periods also bring job scams. Be wary of any posting that asks for payment, banking details or sensitive information before a formal offer, and apply through a company's official website.
segments.tr: 7. **Verify every offer.** Seasonal periods also bring job scams. Be wary of any posting that asks for payment, banking details or sensitive information before a formal offer, and apply through a company's official website.

segments.src: ## What It Says About the Bigger Jobs Picture
segments.tr: ## What It Says About the Bigger Jobs Picture

segments.src: Seasonal hiring is only one piece of the labor market, but it offers a useful signal.
segments.tr: Seasonal hiring is only one piece of the labor market, but it offers a useful signal.

segments.src: Smaller holiday hiring plans can reflect employers' caution about consumer demand, while greater automation points to longer-term changes in how goods move from warehouse to doorstep.
segments.tr: Smaller holiday hiring plans can reflect employers' caution about consumer demand, while greater automation points to longer-term changes in how goods move from warehouse to doorstep.

segments.src: Economists generally caution against reading too much into one season.
segments.tr: Economists generally caution against reading too much into one season.

segments.src: Holiday hiring can be affected by the timing of promotions, weather, supply chain conditions and shifts between online and in-store shopping.
segments.tr: Holiday hiring can be affected by the timing of promotions, weather, supply chain conditions and shifts between online and in-store shopping.

segments.src: A softer seasonal pattern may coincide with steady unemployment and modest job growth, a combination often described as a cooling but not collapsing labor market.
segments.tr: A softer seasonal pattern may coincide with steady unemployment and modest job growth, a combination often described as a cooling but not collapsing labor market.

segments.src: What bears watching in the coming months:
segments.tr: What bears watching in the coming months:

segments.src: - Whether employers keep some seasonal workers on after the holidays
segments.tr: - Whether employers keep some seasonal workers on after the holidays

segments.src: - How quickly job openings and hiring rates continue to move
segments.tr: - How quickly job openings and hiring rates continue to move

segments.src: - Wage growth, especially in retail and logistics
segments.tr: - Wage growth, especially in retail and logistics

segments.src: - Whether automation investment spreads to smaller facilities and more job categories
segments.tr: - Whether automation investment spreads to smaller facilities and more job categories

segments.src: ## The Takeaway
segments.tr: ## The Takeaway

segments.src: The holiday hiring season is still happening, but it reflects a labor market that is less frantic than in recent years and a logistics industry that is steadily becoming more automated.
segments.tr: The holiday hiring season is still happening, but it reflects a labor market that is less frantic than in recent years and a logistics industry that is steadily becoming more automated.

segments.src: For workers, the best approach is to start early, stay flexible, build practical technology skills and research employers carefully.
segments.tr: For workers, the best approach is to start early, stay flexible, build practical technology skills and research employers carefully.

segments.src: For observers of the economy, the season offers one more data point, helpful but best read alongside broader employment reports rather than on its own.
segments.tr: For observers of the economy, the season offers one more data point, helpful but best read alongside broader employment reports rather than on its own.

us-20261103-news-3.title: 美元大年：走势波动的绿钞对游客、出口商及您的投资组合意味着什么

segments.src: When the value of the U.S.
segments.tr: 当美元的价值发生波动时，

segments.src: dollar moves, the effects rarely stay in currency markets.
segments.tr: 其影响很少局限于外汇市场。

segments.src: They show up in the price of a hotel room in Lisbon, in a manufacturer's quarterly earnings, and in the returns on a retirement account that holds international funds.
segments.tr: 这些影响体现在里斯本酒店房间的价格上、制造企业的季度收益中，以及持有国际基金的退休账户的回报率里。

segments.src: This year, the dollar has been a story in its own right.
segments.tr: 今年，美元本身就是一个备受瞩目的焦点话题。

segments.src: Here is a plain-language look at what tends to move the currency, and who typically benefits or loses when it does.
segments.tr: 以下通俗易懂地解读了通常推动该货币波动的因素，以及在波动发生时通常谁会受益或受损。

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not financial, tax or investment advice.*
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般信息参考，不构成财务、税务或投资建议。*

segments.src: ## What Moves the Dollar?
segments.tr: ## 推动美元波动的因素是什么？

segments.src: Exchange rates reflect the relative appeal of one currency against another.
segments.tr: 汇率反映了一种货币相对于另一种货币的吸引力。

segments.src: A handful of forces tend to matter most:
segments.tr: 少数几种力量往往起决定性作用：

segments.src: - **Interest rate expectations.** When investors expect U.S. interest rates to stay higher than those in other major economies, dollar-denominated assets become more attractive, and demand for the currency can rise. When the gap narrows, the opposite can happen.
segments.tr: - **利率预期。** 当投资者预计美国利率将持续高于其他主要经济体时，以美元计价的资产会更具吸引力，对美元的需求也可能上升。当利差缩小 时，情况可能刚好相反。

segments.src: - **Economic growth and data.** Strong U.S. employment, spending and inflation readings can shift expectations about central bank policy. Surprises, in either direction, often cause the sharpest moves.
segments.tr: - **经济增长与数据。** 强劲的美国就业、消费和通胀数据可能会改变对央行政策的预期。无论是哪个方向的意外数据，往往都会引发最剧烈的波动。

segments.src: - **Safe-haven demand.** In periods of global uncertainty, investors have often moved money into U.S. Treasuries, which tends to support the dollar.
segments.tr: - **避险需求。** 在全球不确定性时期，投资者往往会将资金转移到美国国债中，这通常会支撑美元。

segments.src: - **Trade and fiscal policy.** Tariff announcements, trade negotiations and government borrowing plans can all influence how investors view the currency over time.
segments.tr: - **贸易与财政政策。** 关税声明、贸易谈判和政府借贷计划都随着时间的推移影响投资者对该货币的看法。

segments.src: - **Policy in other countries.** The dollar is always quoted against something. A shift in policy at the European Central Bank, the Bank of Japan or elsewhere can move the exchange rate even if U.S. conditions are unchanged.
segments.tr: - **其他国家的政策。** 美元总是相对于某种货币进行报价。即使美国国内情况保持不变，欧洲中央银行、日本银行或其他地方的政策转变也可能推动汇率变化。

segments.src: No single factor explains a year of currency moves.
segments.tr: 没有单一因素能完全解释一整年的货币走势。

segments.src: Analysts often disagree about which ones are dominant, and forecasts have a mixed track record.
segments.tr: 分析师往往对哪些因素占据主导地位持不同意见，而且预测的历史记录参差不齐。

segments.src: ## What It Means for Travelers
segments.tr: ## 对游客意味着什么

segments.src: For Americans traveling abroad, a stronger dollar generally means more purchasing power.
segments.tr: 对于赴海外旅游的美国人来说，美元走强通常意味着更高的购买力。

segments.src: A euro or a yen costs fewer dollars, so meals, lodging and souvenirs can feel cheaper.
segments.tr: 兑换欧元或日元所需的美元更少，因此餐饮、住宿和纪念品感觉会更便宜。

segments.src: A weaker dollar works the other way, nudging up the cost of the same trip.
segments.tr: 美元走弱则恰恰相反，会推高同一趟行程的成本。

segments.src: A few practical tips:
segments.tr: 几条实用建议：

segments.src: 1. **Compare the total cost, not just the headline rate.** Card fees, ATM charges and airport exchange kiosks can erase a favorable exchange rate.
segments.tr: 1. **比较总成本，而不仅仅是表面汇率。** 刷卡费、ATM手续费和机场兑换点可能会吞噬有利的汇率。

segments.src: 2. **Pay in local currency.** When a card terminal offers to charge you in dollars, the conversion rate is often less favorable. Choosing the local currency usually costs less.
segments.tr: 2. **使用当地货币支付。** 当刷卡终端建议以美元结算时，转换汇率通常不太划算。选择当地货币通常花费更少。

segments.src: 3. **Consider cards without foreign transaction fees.** These fees commonly run around 3 percent on some cards, which can add up over a long trip.
segments.tr: 3. **考虑使用无外币交易费的卡。** 这些费用在某些卡上通常占 3% 左右，在漫长的旅程中积少成多。

segments.src: 4. **Prepay big-ticket items when it suits you.** Locking in a hotel or tour price in dollars removes the exchange-rate guesswork, though it may reduce flexibility.
segments.tr: 4. **适时预付大额项目。** 用美元锁定酒店或行程价格可以避免汇率的不确定性，尽管这可能会降低灵活性。

segments.src: For visitors coming to the United States, the reverse applies: a stronger dollar makes American trips more expensive, which can affect tourism-dependent businesses and destinations.
segments.tr: 对于来美国的外国游客而言，情况刚好相反：美元走强使得赴美旅游成本更高，这可能会影响依赖旅游业的企业和目的地。

segments.src: ## What It Means for Exporters and Importers
segments.tr: ## 对出口商和进口商意味着什么

segments.src: A stronger dollar makes U.S.
segments.tr: 美元走强使得美国

segments.src: goods more expensive for foreign buyers, which can weigh on export sales unless companies cut prices and accept thinner margins.
segments.tr: 产品对于外国买家来说更为昂贵，除非企业降价并接受更低的利润率，否则这会压抑出口销售。

segments.src: A weaker dollar tends to help exporters by making their products cheaper abroad.
segments.tr: 美元走弱往往有助于出口商，因为它使他们的产品在海外更加便宜。

segments.src: Importers see the mirror image.
segments.tr: 进口商面临的则是镜象情况。

segments.src: A stronger dollar lowers the cost of foreign-made goods and materials, which can ease costs for retailers and manufacturers that rely on imports.
segments.tr: 美元走强降低了外国制造的产品和原料的成本，这可以减轻依赖进口的零售商和制造商的成本压力。

segments.src: Consumers sometimes benefit through lower prices, though pass-through is uneven and often delayed.
segments.tr: 消费者有时会通过更低的价格受益，尽管传导过程往往不均匀且有延迟。

segments.src: There is also an accounting effect.
segments.tr: 此外还有会计效应。

segments.src: Large multinational companies earn revenue in many currencies.
segments.tr: 大型跨国公司以多种货币赚取收入。

segments.src: When those foreign earnings are converted back into dollars, a stronger dollar shrinks the reported total, and a weaker dollar inflates it.
segments.tr: 当这些海外收益折算回美元时，美元走强会缩减报告的总额，而美元走弱则会使其膨胀。

segments.src: Companies often discuss this in earnings reports as a "currency headwind" or "tailwind," and many use hedging contracts to soften the impact.
segments.tr: 公司经常在财报中将此称为“汇率逆风”或“顺风”，许多公司使用对冲合约来缓解这种影响。

segments.src: ## What It Means for Your Portfolio
segments.tr: ## 对您的投资组合意味着什么

segments.src: Currency movements matter for anyone who owns international investments, including broad funds in a workplace retirement plan.
segments.tr: 对于拥有国际投资的人（包括工作场所退休计划中的广泛基金）来说，汇率波动都很重要。

segments.src: - **International stocks and bonds.** If you hold assets priced in euros, yen or other currencies, their value in dollars depends on both the asset's performance and the exchange rate. A rising dollar can reduce returns on foreign holdings, while a falling dollar can boost them.
segments.tr: - **国际股票和债券。** 如果您持有以欧元、日元或其他货币计价的资产，它们以美元计价的价值既取决于资产本身的表现，也取决于汇率。美元上涨可能会降低海外资产的回报，而美元下跌则可能会提升回报。

segments.src: - **U.S. multinationals.** Companies that earn much of their revenue overseas can see profits swing with the dollar, as described above.
segments.tr: - **美国跨国公司。** 正如上文所述，大部分收入来自海外的公司，其利润可能会随美元波动而起伏。

segments.src: - **Commodities.** Many commodities, including oil and gold, are priced in dollars. A stronger dollar can make them more expensive for buyers using other currencies and sometimes puts downward pressure on prices.
segments.tr: - **大宗商品。** 包括石油和黄金在内的许多大宗商品均以美元计价。美元走强会导致使用其他货币的买家购买成本更高，有时会对价格产生下行压力。

segments.src: - **Hedged versus unhedged funds.** Some funds use contracts to reduce currency effects. These can cost more and may behave differently from unhedged versions, so it is worth reading a fund's description.
segments.tr: - **对冲与非对冲基金。** 一些基金使用合约来减少货币效应。这些基金的成本可能更高，且表现可能与非对冲版本有所不同，因此值得仔细阅读基金的说明书。

segments.src: Currency moves also tend to reverse and re-reverse over time.
segments.tr: 汇率走势随着时间的推移也往往会出现反复逆转。

segments.src: Many long-term investors focus on diversification and their time horizon rather than trying to predict the next shift in the exchange rate.
segments.tr: 许多长期投资者专注于分散投资和自己的投资期限，而不是试图预测下一次汇率转变。

segments.src: If you are unsure how your holdings are exposed, a licensed financial professional can help you review them.
segments.tr: 如果您不确定自己的持仓面临怎样的风险敞口，持牌金融专业人士可以帮助您进行审阅。

segments.src: ## Winners and Losers at a Glance
segments.tr: ## 胜者与败者一览

segments.src: | | Stronger dollar | Weaker dollar |
segments.tr: | | 美元走强 | 美元走弱 |

segments.src: | U.S. travelers abroad | Gain buying power | Face higher costs |
segments.tr: | 海外出游的美国游客 | 获得购买力 | 面临更高成本 |

segments.src: | Foreign visitors to the U.S. | Face higher costs | Gain buying power |
segments.tr: | 赴美旅游的外国游客 | 面临更高成本 | 获得购买力 |

segments.src: | U.S. exporters | Often pressured | Often helped |
segments.tr: | 美国出口商 | 往往面临压力 | 往往获得助力 |

segments.src: | U.S. importers and shoppers | Often helped | Often pressured |
segments.tr: | 美国进口商及消费者 | 往往获得助力 | 往往面临压力 |

segments.src: | Foreign assets held by U.S. investors | Returns may shrink | Returns may grow |
segments.tr: | 美国投资者持有的海外资产 | 回报可能缩水 | 回报可能增加 |

segments.src: These are general tendencies, not guarantees.
segments.tr: 这些是总体趋势，并非绝对保证。

segments.src: Real-world outcomes depend on pricing power, contracts, hedging and timing.
segments.tr: 现实世界的结果取决于定价能力、合同、对冲和时机。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: The dollar's value is a moving piece in the economy that touches nearly everyone, whether or not they ever exchange a single bill.
segments.tr: 美元的价值是经济中动态变化的一环，几乎影响着每个人，无论他们是否兑换过纸币。

segments.src: Travelers can protect their budgets by watching fees and exchange rates, businesses can plan around currency risk, and investors can understand how much of their portfolio depends on foreign currencies.
segments.tr: 游客可以通过关注费用和汇率来规划预算，企业可以围绕汇率风险进行规划，投资者可以了解自己的投资组合中有多少依赖于外币。

segments.src: Staying informed, and keeping a long-term view, is usually more useful than reacting to each day's headline.
segments.tr: 保持信息通畅并坚持长期视角，通常比对每天的头条新闻做出反应更为实用。

us-20261103-news-2.title: 牛肉、咖啡和可可：为什么一些日常杂货的价格不断创下新高

segments.src: Overall inflation has cooled from its peak, but anyone who has stood in a grocery aisle lately knows the headline number does not tell the whole story.
segments.tr: 总体通胀率已从峰值回落，但最近去过杂货店的人都知道，总体数据并不能说明全部情况。

segments.src: A handful of everyday items, including **beef, coffee and chocolate**, have stayed stubbornly expensive.
segments.tr: 少数日常用品，包括**牛肉、咖啡和巧克力**，价格依然居高不下。

segments.src: Each has its own cause, and each has a different outlook for relief.
segments.tr: 每种商品都有其自身的原因，缓解的前景也各不相同。

segments.src: > **Note:** This article is general background, not financial or purchasing advice. Prices vary by region, store and week, so check current figures from official sources such as the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics and the USDA.
segments.tr: > **注意：** 本文仅供一般背景参考，不构成财务或购买建议。价格因地区、商店和周次而异，请查看美国劳工统计局 (U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics) 和美国农业部 (USDA) 等官方来源的最新数据。

segments.src: ## Why averages can hide big differences
segments.tr: ## 为什么平均值会掩盖巨大的差异

segments.src: Consumer price indexes blend hundreds of goods.
segments.tr: 消费者价格指数涵盖了数百种商品。

segments.src: When energy costs ease or used-car prices fall, they can pull the overall figure down even while certain foods keep climbing.
segments.tr: 当能源成本下降或二手车价格下跌时，它们可以拉低整体数据，即使某些食品的价格仍在攀升。

segments.src: Food is also unusually exposed to things that sit outside normal economic cycles: weather, animal biology, crop disease and trade policy.
segments.tr: 食品也异常容易受到正常经济周期之外因素的影响：天气、动物生物学、作物病害和贸易政策。

segments.src: That is why a few staples can keep setting records in a calmer inflation environment.
segments.tr: 这就是为什么在通胀环境趋于平缓的情况下，一些主食价格仍能不断创下新高的原因。

segments.src: ## Beef: it takes years to make more cattle
segments.tr: ## 牛肉：增加牛群数量需要数年时间

segments.src: Beef prices are largely a story about **supply that cannot be rebuilt quickly**.
segments.tr: 牛肉价格在很大程度上是一个关于**无法快速重建的供应**的故事。

segments.src: - **Herd size.** The U.S. cattle herd has shrunk to some of its lowest levels in decades. Several years of drought across major grazing regions pushed ranchers to sell animals early because pasture and hay were scarce or costly.
segments.tr: - **牛群规模。** 美国的牛群规模已缩减至几十年来最低水平。主要放牧区连续几年的干旱迫使牧场主提前出售牲畜，因为牧场和干草稀缺或成本高昂。

segments.src: - **Biology and timing.** A heifer kept back to build the herd is not available for slaughter. It then takes roughly two years or more before her calf reaches market weight. Rebuilding therefore reduces beef supply before it increases it.
segments.tr: - **生物学和时间。** 为扩大牛群而留下的母牛无法用于屠宰。此后，小牛长到市场重量大约需要两年或更长时间。因此，重建牛群在增加供应之前会先减少牛肉供应。

segments.src: - **Costs along the chain.** Feed, fuel, labor and processing costs all affect what ends up in the meat case.
segments.tr: - **产业链成本。** 饲料、燃料、劳动力和加工成本都会影响肉类柜台最终的价格。

segments.src: - **Trade.** The U.S. imports a meaningful amount of lean beef used in ground products. Tariffs, import limits and shifts in supplier countries can raise costs for those cuts.
segments.tr: - **贸易。** 美国进口大量用于绞肉产品的瘦牛肉。关税、进口限制和供应国变动可能会提高这些肉块的成本。

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Probably not soon.
segments.tr: **价格会缓解吗？** 可能不会很快。

segments.src: Analysts generally expect tight supplies to persist until herds rebuild, and that process can take years.
segments.tr: 分析师普遍预计，在牛群重建之前，供应紧张的局面将持续存在，而这一过程可能需要数年时间。

segments.src: Good rains and cheaper feed would help, but the lag is built into the cattle cycle.
segments.tr: 充足的雨水和更便宜的饲料会有所帮助，但滞后性是牛群周期中固有的。

segments.src: ## Coffee: a weather-driven crop in a few places
segments.tr: ## 咖啡：少数几个地区的天气驱动型作物

segments.src: Coffee is grown in a small number of regions, so trouble in one can ripple through the global market.
segments.tr: 咖啡种植在少数几个地区，因此其中一个地区出现问题就可能波及全球市场。

segments.src: - **Climate stress.** Droughts, heat and irregular rains in major producers such as Brazil and Vietnam have reduced harvests in some seasons. Arabica, the variety common in specialty drinks, is especially sensitive to temperature and rainfall.
segments.tr: - **气候压力。** 巴西和越南等主要生产国的干旱、高温和不规律降雨在某些季节减少了收成。阿拉比卡咖啡（Arabica）是特色饮品中常见的品种，对温度和降雨量特别敏感。

segments.src: - **Slow replanting.** A new coffee tree takes several years to bear a full crop, so losses cannot be fixed in a single season.
segments.tr: - **重新种植缓慢。** 一棵新的咖啡树需要几年时间才能结出完整的果实，因此损失无法在一个季节内修复。

segments.src: - **Shipping and trade costs.** Freight disruptions, currency swings and import tariffs add to what roasters pay.
segments.tr: - **运输和贸易成本。** 货运中断、汇率波动和进口关税增加了烘焙商的成本。

segments.src: - **Retail lag.** Roasters often buy ahead and use hedging contracts, so changes in the commodity price can take months to show up on shelves, in both directions.
segments.tr: - **零售滞后。** 烘焙商通常会提前购买并使用对冲合约，因此商品价格的变化可能需要几个月的时间才能在货架上显现出来，无论是上涨还是下跌。

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** It depends on harvests.
segments.tr: **价格会缓解吗？** 这取决于收成。

segments.src: Larger crops in key countries can bring wholesale prices down, but retail prices tend to fall more slowly than they rose.
segments.tr: 关键国家的丰收可以降低批发价格，但零售价格的下跌速度往往比上涨速度慢。

segments.src: Shoppers may see more promotions before they see lower sticker prices.
segments.tr: 购物者在看到标价下降之前，可能会先看到更多的促销活动。

segments.src: ## Cocoa: disease, weather and concentrated supply
segments.tr: ## 可可：疾病、天气和集中的供应

segments.src: Chocolate prices reflect one of the most concentrated supply chains in food.
segments.tr: 巧克力价格反映了食品行业中最集中的供应链之一。

segments.src: A large share of the world's cocoa comes from West Africa, particularly Ivory Coast and Ghana.
segments.tr: 世界上大部分可可来自西非，特别是科特迪瓦和加纳。

segments.src: - **Crop problems.** Heavy rain, dry spells and plant diseases such as swollen shoot virus have cut yields in recent seasons.
segments.tr: - **作物问题。** 近几个季节，大雨、干旱和诸如肿枝病毒 (swollen shoot virus) 等植物病害导致产量下降。

segments.src: - **Aging trees and thin margins.** Many farms have older trees and limited money for replanting, which holds back production.
segments.tr: - **树木老化和利润微薄。** 许多农场的树木较老，且缺乏重新种植的资金，这制约了生产。

segments.src: - **Pass-through to products.** Manufacturers have responded with higher prices, smaller packages or recipe changes. Because cocoa is only one ingredient alongside sugar, dairy and packaging, the effect on a candy bar shows up with a delay.
segments.tr: - **向产品传导。** 制造商通过提高价格、缩小包装或改变配方来应对。由于可可是糖、乳制品和包装之外的单一成分，因此对糖果棒的影响会有所延迟。

segments.src: - **Demand response.** When prices stay high, some buyers trade down or buy less, which can eventually ease pressure on the market.
segments.tr: - **需求反应。** 当价格保持高位时，一些买家会转向更便宜的替代品或减少购买，这最终可以缓解市场压力。

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Cocoa can swing sharply with each harvest report.
segments.tr: **价格会缓解吗？** 可可价格会随着每份收成报告而剧烈波动。

segments.src: A strong recovery in West African output would help, but analysts caution that retail chocolate prices usually adjust slowly even after raw cocoa falls.
segments.tr: 西非产量的强劲复苏会有所帮助，但分析师提醒说，即使在原材料可可价格下跌后，零售巧克力价格通常也会缓慢调整。

segments.src: ## What the three have in common
segments.tr: ## 这三者的共同点

segments.src: | Item | Main pressure | Why relief is slow |
segments.tr: | 商品 | 主要压力 | 缓解缓慢的原因 |

segments.src: | Beef | Small cattle herd, drought, trade costs | Rebuilding herds takes years |
segments.tr: | 牛肉 | 牛群规模小、干旱、贸易成本 | 重建牛群需要数年 |

segments.src: | Coffee | Weather in a few key regions, shipping | New trees need years to produce |
segments.tr: | 咖啡 | 少数关键地区的天气、运输 | 新树需要几年才能产出 |

segments.src: | Cocoa | Disease, weather, concentrated supply | Retail prices lag the raw commodity |
segments.tr: | 可可 | 疾病、天气、供应集中 | 零售价格滞后于原材料商品 |

segments.src: In each case, the problem is **supply that responds slowly**, combined with costs that tend to be passed on quickly and rolled back slowly.
segments.tr: 在每种情况下，问题都是**供应反应缓慢**，加上成本往往会迅速转嫁并缓慢回落。

segments.src: Economists often describe this as price stickiness: companies are quicker to raise prices than to cut them.
segments.tr: 经济学家通常将其描述为价格粘性：企业提高价格的速度比降低价格的速度要快。

segments.src: ## Practical ways households cope
segments.tr: ## 家庭应对的实用方法

segments.src: - **Shift cuts.** Ground beef, chuck and other less expensive cuts often cost less than steaks, and slow cooking makes them tender.
segments.tr: - **更换肉块。** 牛绞肉、牛肩肉和其他较便宜的肉块通常比牛排便宜，慢炖可以使它们变嫩。

segments.src: - **Mix proteins.** Substituting chicken, eggs, beans or lentils in some meals can lower the weekly bill.
segments.tr: - **混合蛋白质。** 在某些餐食中用鸡肉、鸡蛋、豆类或扁豆代替牛肉可以降低每周的开支。

segments.src: - **Compare coffee formats.** Store brands, larger bags or whole beans ground at home can reduce cost per cup. Watch the unit price rather than the package price.
segments.tr: - **比较咖啡形式。** 商店自有品牌、大包装或在家研磨的整豆可以降低每杯的成本。关注单位价格而不是包装价格。

segments.src: - **Buy chocolate on promotion.** Seasonal sales and store brands can offer savings, and baking chocolate can substitute for some recipes.
segments.tr: - **在促销时购买巧克力。** 季节性销售和商店自有品牌可以节省开支，烘焙巧克力可以替代某些食谱中的巧克力。

segments.src: - **Use unit prices.** Shrinking package sizes can make a price look unchanged when it is not.
segments.tr: - **使用单位价格。** 缩小的包装尺寸可能会让价格看起来没有变化，但实际上并非如此。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: Cooling overall inflation does not mean every price falls together.
segments.tr: 总体通胀降温并不意味着所有价格都会同时下跌。

segments.src: Beef, coffee and cocoa are held up by herds, harvests and trade costs that cannot be fixed quickly.
segments.tr: 牛肉、咖啡和可可的价格受到牛群、收成和贸易成本的支撑，这些问题无法迅速解决。

segments.src: Relief is most likely to arrive gradually, through better weather, bigger crops and rebuilt herds, and it will probably reach store shelves later than it reaches commodity markets.
segments.tr: 缓解最有可能通过更好的天气、更大的收成和重建的牛群逐渐到来，而且它到达商店货架的时间可能会晚于到达商品市场的时间。

segments.src: Until then, flexible shopping habits are the most reliable tool consumers have.
segments.tr: 在此之前，灵活的购物习惯是消费者拥有的最可靠的工具。
